prompt: which cities should I visit in japan on a 30 day trip? I'm into history, culture, food, fashion/design, nightlife/clubbing
response: For a 30-day trip, you can cover more ground by visiting Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, and Hiroshima. Start in Tokyo for its cutting-edge technology and fashion, then move to Kyoto for its rich history and traditional culture. Osaka is great for food and nightlife, and Hiroshima offers a poignant look at modern history. This itinerary allows you to experience different facets of Japan.
